capture_filter: tcp port 18023 or tcp port 2121 or portrange 19000-19009
notes: All traffic stayed inside documentation-range addresses in dedicated namespaces.
FTP username/password were synthetic lab values and are redacted in submitted transcripts; no host account or real data used.
Telnet frame 6 contains inetutils negotiation bytes; FTP frames include USER/PASS/230, EPSV/229, RETR/125/226 and a separate data four-tuple.
Dedicated active-mode capture is captures/real-app-netns/ftp-active.pcapng; EPRT/LIST/226 fields are in ftp-active.frames.tsv.
